name: Eyes on Earth — Underpowered Thermal Surveyor
description: Failing test fixture: insufficient electrical power. The spacecraft couples energy-intensive high-performance components (Thermal Infrared Imager, Precision ADCS, Advanced OBC, and X-Band HGA) with an entry-level Standard Solar Array (80 W), producing an acute power shortfall during sunlit orbital operations.

expectedScore.note: Feasibility fails at FC-3 (Power compliance). The spacecraft suffers brownouts during normal daytime operations.

failureExplanation: The total power draw of all active subsystems is 91.0 W (X-Band HGA: 25 W, Advanced OBC: 20 W, Precision ADCS: 18 W, Thermal Infrared Imager: 28 W). With the mandatory 1.1 safety reserve factor, the spacecraft requires at least 100.1 W of power generation in sunlight. The Standard Solar Array generates only 80.0 W, leaving a 20.1 W deficit (-20% shortfall). To resolve this failure, the player must upgrade to the High-Efficiency Solar Array (140.0 W) or swap out power-hungry components for lower-power alternatives.
